name: PlacementDecision
description: PlacementDecision represents the result of a Placement resource. It contains the list of selected ManagedClusters that match the Placement conditions. Each PlacementDecision must be labeled with cluster.open-cluster-management.io/placement=<placement-name> to link it to its Placement.
usageHint: This is used internally by OCM to record which ManagedClusters were selected by a Placement. The status.decisions field contains the actual decision list.
